from pathlib import Path
import openpyxl
out=Path('staging_asxl1')
out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
w=openpyxl.load_workbook('inputs/Issy_ASXL1_blood_coldata_gender.xlsx',read_only=True,data_only=True)
rows=[r for r in w.active.iter_rows(min_row=2,values_only=True) if r[0]]
meta={r[0]:(r[2],r[1]) for r in rows}
with open('inputs/Issy_ASXL1_blood_featureCounts_GeneTable_final.txt') as f:
 header=f.readline().split()
 wanted=[s for s in header[1:] if s in meta]
 assert len(wanted)==19 and set(wanted)==set(meta)
 ix=[header.index(s) for s in wanted]
 handles={s:(out/f'{s}.counts').open('w') for s in wanted}
 try:
  for s in wanted: handles[s].write(f'Geneid\\t{s}\\n')
  n=0
  for line in f:
   fields=line.split()
   if not fields: continue
   assert len(fields)==len(header)
   gene=fields[0]
   for s,j in zip(wanted,ix): handles[s].write(f'{gene}\\t{fields[j]}\\n')
   n+=1
 finally:
  for h in handles.values(): h.close()
with (out/'sample_sheet.tsv').open('w') as f:
 f.write('sample\\tsex\\tcondition\\n')
 for s in wanted:
  sex,condition=meta[s]
  f.write(f'{s}\\t{sex}\\t{condition}\\n')
assert n==60662
print(out.resolve())
print('files',len(list(out.iterdir())),'genes_per_count_file',n,'sample_order',','.join(wanted))

    --output result.tsv

inputs:

representation.name: ASXL1 DESeq2 apeglm with sex covariate
representation.shell_command:
set -eu
Rscript --vanilla - "$(inputs.count_matrix.path)" "$(inputs.sample_sheet.path)" results.tsv summary.tsv <<'RSCRIPT'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
count_path <- args[[1]]
sample_path <- args[[2]]
result_path <- args[[3]]
summary_path <- args[[4]]

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(DESeq2)
  library(apeglm)
  library(BiocParallel)
})

workers <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(Sys.getenv("GALAXY_SLOTS", "1")))
if (is.na(workers) || workers < 1L) workers <- 1L
if (workers > 1L) register(MulticoreParam(workers))

counts_df <- read.table(
  count_path,
  header = TRUE,
  sep = "",
  quote = "",
  comment.char = "",
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
if (ncol(counts_df) < 2L) stop("Count matrix must contain a gene ID column and sample columns")
gene_id <- counts_df[[1]]
if (anyDuplicated(gene_id)) stop("Gene identifiers are duplicated")
rownames(counts_df) <- gene_id
counts_df[[1]] <- NULL

sample_info <- read.delim(
  sample_path,
  header = TRUE,
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
required_cols <- c("sample", "sex", "condition")
if (!all(required_cols %in% colnames(sample_info))) stop("Sample sheet lacks required columns")
if (anyDuplicated(sample_info$sample)) stop("Sample identifiers are duplicated")
if (!all(sample_info$sample %in% colnames(counts_df))) stop("A sample-sheet sample is absent from the count matrix")

count_mat <- as.matrix(counts_df[, sample_info$sample, drop = FALSE])
storage.mode(count_mat) <- "integer"
if (anyNA(count_mat) || any(count_mat < 0L)) stop("Counts must be nonnegative integers")
if (!identical(colnames(count_mat), sample_info$sample)) stop("Count and metadata sample order mismatch")

sample_info$sex <- factor(sample_info$sex)
sample_info$condition <- factor(sample_info$condition, levels = c("Control", "ASXL1"))
if (anyNA(sample_info$condition)) stop("Unexpected condition level")
rownames(sample_info) <- sample_info$sample

dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = count_mat,
  colData = sample_info,
  design = ~ sex + condition
)
dds <- DESeq(dds, parallel = workers > 1L)
coef_name <- "condition_ASXL1_vs_Control"
if (!(coef_name %in% resultsNames(dds))) {
  stop(paste("Required coefficient missing. Available:", paste(resultsNames(dds), collapse = ",")))
}
unshrunk <- results(
  dds,
  name = coef_name,
  alpha = 0.05,
  independentFiltering = TRUE,
  cooksCutoff = TRUE
)
shrunk <- lfcShrink(
  dds,
  coef = coef_name,
  res = unshrunk,
  type = "apeglm",
  parallel = workers > 1L
)
if (!("pvalue" %in% names(shrunk))) shrunk$pvalue <- unshrunk$pvalue
